mapper.update: UPDATE t_pair_session SET initiator_visible_flag = IF(initiator_open_id = #{openId}, 0, initiator_visible_flag), partner_visible_flag = IF(partner_open_id = #{openId}, 0, partner_visible_flag), pair_status = IF(pair_status IN (1, 2, 3), 6, pair_status) WHERE deleted = 0 AND (initiator_open_id = #{openId} OR partner_open_id = #{openId})
UPDATE t_answer_detail d INNER JOIN t_answer_session s ON s.id = d.answer_session_id SET d.deleted = 1 WHERE s.open_id = #{openId} AND d.deleted = 0
UPDATE t_answer_session_question q INNER JOIN t_answer_session s ON s.id = q.answer_session_id SET q.deleted = 1 WHERE s.open_id = #{openId} AND q.deleted = 0
UPDATE t_report r INNER JOIN t_answer_session s ON s.id = r.answer_session_id SET r.deleted = 1 WHERE s.open_id = #{openId} AND r.deleted = 0
UPDATE t_report_access SET deleted = 1 WHERE open_id = #{openId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE t_report_ad_task SET deleted = 1 WHERE open_id = #{openId} AND deleted = 0
